pairing_rule: Each pair_id has exactly one act row and one abstain row.
task_id_policy: Harbor task names use neutral variant-a/variant-b suffixes. The act/abstain mapping is stored only in verifier metadata.

source_semantics.act: The original execution DAG is preserved and commit tools are expected to be called.
source_semantics.abstain: The original abstention trigger and critical action set are preserved and commit tools must not be called.

verification_components: deterministic commit check over the tool execution log
LLM response judge over the final response
prompt_transport: The native system prompt and user request are labeled separately in instruction.md because Harbor tasks provide one instruction file. Formal parity must apply this same transport to both sides.
runtime_isolation: Initial state and task configuration are held by a private runtime sidecar. The main agent container receives filtered schemas and a read-only execution-log volume.
parity_subset_policy: Four deterministically ranked pairs per category, then additional pairs selected by environment coverage until all 42 environments are represented. Current result is 47 pairs and 94 variants.
scope_note: The adapter initially targets the public 526-row task corpus. Private fresh-generation rounds are outside this adapter scope.
